subject: Insurance
title: The Life Settlement Market
description: Learn The Life Settlement Market in one minute.

hook.text: Sick of paying premiums? You can sell your life insurance policy to an investor for cash.

buildup.text: Life settlements typically pay 20-40% of the death benefit. A $1 million policy might sell for $250,000 cash today.

discovery.text: The industry is legal and regulated.

twist.text: Investors profit when the insured dies sooner than expected.

climax.text: Life settlements turned insurance policies into tradable financial assets. Your death is now an investment opportunity.

punchline.text: Sell your policy for cash. An investor waits for your death to profit.

quiz.question: What is a life settlement?
options: Selling your life insurance policy to an investor for cash
